name: mstack-skill-creator
description: Create or improve agent skills (SKILL.md folders) that Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Cursor all load: an interview, a check for an existing skill, writing by portable rules, a static check, a comparison test against a baseline, and for an mstack-style repository the full plugin packaging and cross-vendor review. Uses the other mstack skills when they are installed. Never commits or publishes on its own.
